newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Citibank raises stake in Colombian pension fund.
newsitem.headline: Citibank raises stake in Colombian pension fund.

text.p: Citibank has increased its stake in Colombia's third largest pension fund, Colfondos, by snapping up an additional 26.7 percent of the firm, a Colfondos executive said Monday.
The official, who spoke on condition he would not be identified by name, said the latest purchase, carried out on April 15, gave Citibank over 80.1 percent of Colfondos.

It had a 53.4 percent stake in the pension fund before the latest deal, in which an additional 26.7 percent of Colfondos' stock was purchased from the Julio Mario Santo Domingo conglomerate, the official said.
He said the new investment was made by Citibank Overseas Investment Corp and not by Citibank's local subsidiary.
Colombia established its private pension fund system in 1994 and a total of nine now operate across the country.
A total of $133.4 million in funds were under Colfondos' management as of December 1996, when it was reported to have 293,691 affiliates and about 17 percent of total fund assets.
